title: RaeveN's Perfected
description: A friendly, enhanced take on vanilla Minecraft. This modpack offers gameplay overhauls and quality-of-life tweaks that make Minecraft more immersive and polished — all while keeping the classic vanilla feel.
body:
## This is my personal way of making Minecraft ##

**Minecraft should feel more **friendly, immersive, and enjoyable**!**

It features a variety of gameplay overhauls and quality-of-life improvements that enrich the experience while staying true to the core mechanics.

Expect smoother visuals, refined systems, and expanded possibilities that enhance the game without overwhelming it. Perfect for players who want a more dynamic and polished version of Minecraft, but still want it to feel like Minecraft.

###     Features
- ⚡ Performance – Experience significantly smoother gameplay compared to vanilla Minecraft.
 
- 🌅 Shaders – Treat your eyes to a richer, more detailed, and vibrant visual world.
 
- 🕺 Animations – Stay immersed with a variety of fresh, dynamic animations.
 
- 🎧 Sound Overhaul – Enjoy an upgraded audio experience that brings Minecraft’s world to life in your headphones.
 
- 🔦 Lighting Overhaul – Explore dark caves with realistic lighting, torch in hand, for a true adventure feel.

- 🎣 Fishing Overhaul – Catch realistic fish and discover loot crates of various tiers filled with surprises.
 
- 🏘️ Settlements – Visit bustling villages and protect your treasures from hostile forces.
 
- 🐉 Mob Variety – Encounter unique creatures you’ve never seen in vanilla Minecraft.
 
- 🛡️ Gameplay Tools – Access powerful tools to craft your ultimate endgame technical builds.
 
- 🎒 Backpacks – Craft portable backpacks to carry all your loot on long adventures.
